verdict.rationale: Teller is a banking-data API, so asking whether it offers versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version headers, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The cited docs cover endpoints, mTLS authentication, webhooks, idempotency and pagination, none of which address versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
